scheduler.selection_reason: A pre-open exogenous local weather observation can change same-session market direction without reusing closed price, volatility, macro-surprise, calendar-rank, native-signal, exit, sizing or portfolio-state decisions.
scheduler.distance_from_unit_113: Unit 113 used a weekly scheduled entertainment release count and a next-week long-only horizon. Unit 114 uses four same-morning physical sky observations and a same-day bidirectional cash rule; neither source, transform, horizon nor direction rule overlaps.
scheduler.whole_map_comparison: Programs 1, 3, 4, 5 and 7 had no comparably complete independent causal source after the formula, price-pattern, calendar, macro-state, management, capacity and meta axes already closed. The weather rule alone provides dense post-paper evidence through the latest period with exact pre-open observability.

literature.paper: David Hirshleifer and Tyler Shumway, Good Day Sunshine: Stock Returns and the Weather, Journal of Finance 58(3), 2003, 1009-1032
literature.morning_measure: average sky cover from 5 a.m. through 8 a.m. local time
literature.transaction_cost_rule: LONG if average morning sky cover is between zero and four inclusive; SHORT otherwise
literature.reported_scope: 26 international exchanges, with a sunny-minus-overcast return difference and a separate transaction-cost exercise
literature.transfer_scope: New York LaGuardia morning sky cover to same-day FPMarkets US500 regular-cash direction
literature.nonclaim: The transfer neither reproduces the paper's full country panel nor refutes the historical paper sample.

source.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
source.lineage: LCDv2 hourly observations are derived from GHCNh and the station/year CSVs expose current routine FM-15 METAR sky conditions.
source.source_clock: LCDv2 DATE is local standard time; attach fixed UTC-05:00 before converting to actual America/New_York time.
source.hour_selection: nearest actual-local minute to 51, then later minute, UTC timestamp and source row
source.daily_measure: arithmetic mean of exactly four selected hourly amounts
source.primary_direction: LONG when mean <= 4.0, SHORT when mean > 4.0

engineering_correction.parser_correction: LaGuardia routine METAR sky codes reside in sky_cover_summation_* rather than the provisional sky_cover_layer_* assumption.
engineering_correction.environment_fault: Even after parser correction, direct GHCNh LaGuardia FM15 rows stopped at 2026-04-13 and supplied zero complete P5 days.
engineering_correction.outcome_state: No M15 price, spread, return, P/L, PF, DD, control or verdict was loaded or calculated.
engineering_correction.correction: Discard the provisional family raw surface and reacquire all five years from one uniform current NOAA LCDv2 series; do not splice only the tail.

boundary.source_independence: The family contains no MQL and includes or links no Live, Optimization, Lab baseline or other research family source.

trade_rule.direction: LONG when the four-hour mean is <= 4.0, SHORT otherwise
trade_rule.gross: direction times midpoint exit minus midpoint entry
trade_rule.observed: direction-correct executable bid/ask entry and exit
trade_rule.binding_stress: gross less the full entry-plus-exit spread burden

economic_gate_summary.density: Every period and P1 split must meet frozen eligible-day minima, both directions must meet period minima, and every latest weather observation must precede entry.
economic_gate_summary.p1: positive stressed net, PF >= 1.05, net/DD >= 1.25, all three splits positive, >=55% positive months, both direction-side contributions positive and net above unconditional LONG
economic_gate_summary.confirmation: P2-P4 all positive; at least two periods beat unconditional LONG, have both sides positive and meet >=50% positive-month breadth
economic_gate_summary.prelatest: positive stressed net, PF >= 1.075, net/DD >= 1.50, >=55% positive months, top-five positive-day share <=35%, both sides positive and net above unconditional LONG
economic_gate_summary.latest: nominal net >=0; practical loss no worse than 25% of positive prelatest mean times latest days
economic_gate_summary.full: positive stressed net, PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, both sides positive and net above unconditional LONG
economic_gate_summary.strong_null: P1 and full/prelatest nonpositive with at most one positive confirmation period
